text:
sam: Quick heads-up — Priya's birthday is on Tue 18th. thinking of two options: 1) afternoon masala chai + samosa spread at 3:15 (short and cozy) OR 2) "desk cinema" theme: tiny movie posters + popcorn cups at desks for a silly walk-by reveal. which do people want? :tea: :popcorn:
priya: (reading but please pretend surprised) omg you all are loud and kind :heart: either works for me, low-key please.
maya: i'm team chai + samosas. less crumbs, slightly less chaos.
oscar: desk cinema sounds hilarious. can we do popcorn in little sealed cups?
people-ops-bot: Poll posted: react to vote: :one: Chai + samosas  :two: Desk cinema (popcorn cups)  :three: Card & quiet (no food)
sam: also remote folks — option to send a postcard or a small snack box. we can mail from the office if we collect funds.
jen: love the postcard idea. i'll make a tiny design. link to e-card: https://tinyurl.com/priya-card
people-ops-bot: Team budget available: $50. collection for extras: https://pay.example.com/priya-bday (suggested $5-15). want a collection created? react with :+1:.
maya: :+1: create collection. i'll chip in $10.
oscar: voted :two: Desk cinema :popcorn: (i can do posters)
jen: voted :one: Chai + samosas but will help make the montage.
sam: how about quick hybrid: set up chai in kitchen and popcorn cups on desks, then choose final based on poll? open to both if budget allows.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: Collect short video shoutouts by Mon 5pm. will post a reminder for remote folks.
priya: (again reading) i'm trying to be surprised here, but thank you all 60a
jen: i'll compile a 20s montage if people send 5-8s clips by Mon noon.
oscar: i'll bring a silent bell for dramatic entry (tiny, not loud).
people-ops-bot: Poll closes Sun 7pm. event draft created: "Priya surprise: chai or cinema" Tue 15:15-15:45 (Kitchen + Desk walk-by + Zoom). Invite to be finalized after poll.
remind-bot: Reminder created: "Postcard addresses & clips due" Mon 5pm.
sam: final note: keep it quiet on slack threads — Priya checks here a lot. :shushing_face:
priya: (last reading) you're all the best. i'll pretend i had no idea. :blush:

(End of thread)
